title: FaceBench: A Multi-View Multi-Level Facial Attribute VQA Dataset for Benchmarking Face Perception MLLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of benchmarking how accurately Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perceive facial attributes such as physical appearance, accessories, identity traits (race, gender, age), and psychology (emotions and action units). It does not contain an evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
